details: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated following reports of US forces destroying five Iranian oil tankers and Iran attacking ten vessels near the Strait of Hormuz. This situation has driven Brent crude oil prices above $100 per barrel, reigniting inflation fears and increasing the likelihood of central bank interest rate hikes. The resulting uncertainty and "risk-off" sentiment are putting downward pressure on Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, accompanied by significant ETF outflows.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Boosting Oil Prices and Hurting Crypto

details: Major central banks, including the European Central Bank (ECB), have recently raised interest rates by 25 basis points, with expectations of further hikes due to persistent inflation and energy-driven price pressures. Recent US Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) data reinforced these concerns, pushing up US Treasury yields. This global tightening of monetary policy increases borrowing costs, reduces liquidity for speculative assets, and creates a challenging environment for cryptocurrencies.
title: Central Banks Eye Further Rate Hikes on Inflation Concerns
